head.text: Both pages run in the same viewer and read pure data files. The skills page is built from the frontmatter of every published SKILL.md; the marks page presents the seven speed marks and the two kept from the earlier round, Two-way and Globe G, each on paper and on ink at every size. Both crops follow the deck theme.

figures.caption: 261 skills in three groups: 209 engineering and 39 productivity skills from the wiki and 13 from the General Translation repository, each row a number, a name and a description.

The presentation field of the marks page: the seven speed marks and the two kept marks, Two-way and Globe G, together at one height, positive; the page repeats the field reversed on ink. Every file is one color in currentColor with a tight viewBox.
